tools.name: compliance_check
tools.description: Analyze regulatory obligations for a company based on jurisdiction, size and sector. Returns applicable frameworks, risk level and priority actions.

jurisdiction.description: ISO code (e.g. QC, FR, DE, US)

tools.name: jurisdiction_map
tools.description: Get applicable regulatory frameworks for a jurisdiction. Without a jurisdiction parameter, returns all 192 jurisdictions.

jurisdiction.description: ISO code (e.g. QC, FR, DE). Omit for full list.

tools.name: compliance_roadmap
tools.description: Generate a phased compliance action plan with cost estimates adapted to SME budgets.

jurisdiction.description: ISO code (e.g. QC, FR, DE, US)

timeline_months.description: Number of months for the plan

tools.name: algorithmic_compliance_assessment
tools.description: Assess algorithmic compliance maturity for AI systems. Returns applicable frameworks (EU AI Act, Law 25, AIDA/C-27, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF), sector-specific obligations and assessment dimensions.

jurisdiction.description: ISO code (e.g. QC, FR, DE, US, EU)

sector.description: e.g. health, finance, hr, legal, tech, education, retail, manufacturing

tools.name: authority_decide
tools.description: Deterministic, rule-based advisory decision (no LLM) on whether an AI agent may execute an action: ALLOW, APPROVE (human approval required), DENY (human-only decision) or ESCALATE (doubt threshold). Cites applicable frameworks per jurisdiction and sector, and returns an evidence record. Advisory only: StructureClerk decides, your infrastructure enforces.

type.description: Dotted action type, e.g. payment.execute, read.contract

data_categories.description: e.g. personal, health, biometric, minors, financial

jurisdictions.description: ISO codes, e.g. QC, FR, EU

sector.description: e.g. health, finance, public, insurance, tech
